basic_info.description: What are the true virtues of our sparkling city? Is it the temperate climate, lush parks, surfable beaches, iconic Bay, & secret stair walks? Is it world class museums & culture, innovative dining, book shops & bars?  Or egg tarts from Pineapple King Bakery? Now, you can have it all! Roll out of bed in this airy, sophisticated, full floor penthouse with a private terrace, & enjoy the city in all its glory. The lofty residence has majestic gallery walls,  a luminous, spacious sky-lit kitchen, & an open-plan living space, perfect for entertaining. A handsome barn door encloses the handy in-unit laundry, + storage, a useful office is tucked in the hall. Luxe baths with EXQUST tile work accompany 3 serene bedrooms. The primary suite accesses the private terrace overlooking the garden & leafy tree tops, a daily reminder of the rich assets of the neighbor, majestic Golden Gate Park. Dual glazed windows keep the peace, & fresh refinished floors warm the home. One car parking + EV charging & shared garden complete the irresistible residence. With spectacular city centrality, the location is proximate to Ocean Beach, De Young Museum & easy commute to Fidi, SFO, + South Bay. A special home for nature lovers, hikers, surfers, gourmands, & especially those gifted good taste & a green thumb.
